rules: Never relabel an inferred or modelled record as reported.
Keep source date, publisher, licence, original identifier and source URL with every integrated record.
Prefer official geometry and attributes; use verified research to fill documented gaps; retain self-hosted OSM and Natural Earth as geographic context.
Operational status fields are historical snapshots unless the source explicitly supplies live telemetry.

sources.publisher: OpenStreetMap contributors; regional extracts distributed by Geofabrik GmbH
sources.title: Project-built OpenStreetMap power infrastructure snapshots
sources.licence: Open Database License 1.0; attribution to OpenStreetMap contributors is required
sources.redistribution: self-hosted PMTiles derived from dated Geofabrik OSM PBF extracts; source and output hashes, tool versions, feature counts and bounds are recorded in the manifest
sources.pipeline: osmium tags-filter/export → project schema normalization → tippecanoe MVT → PMTiles
limitations: community-mapped snapshot rather than live telemetry
missing tags remain unknown and are never inferred
continental-U.S. coverage is clipped to the declared atlas bounds

sources.publisher: OpenStreetMap contributors; regional extracts distributed by Geofabrik GmbH
sources.title: Project-built regional road and place context
sources.licence: Open Database License 1.0; attribution to OpenStreetMap contributors is required
sources.redistribution: self-hosted regional PMTiles derived from the same dated Geofabrik OSM PBF extracts as the electrical layers; source and output hashes, tool versions, feature counts and bounds are recorded in the manifest
sources.pipeline: osmium tags-filter/export → compact road and place schema → tippecanoe MVT → PMTiles
limitations: regional orientation context rather than a navigation map
only motorway, trunk and primary road classes and selected populated places are included
community-mapped names and classifications remain a dated snapshot

sources.title: Natural Earth 1:10m global geographic context
sources.redistribution: selected public-domain Natural Earth vector layers are normalized and served as one self-hosted PMTiles archive; input and output hashes are recorded in the manifest
sources.pipeline: Natural Earth GeoJSON → project context schema → tippecanoe MVT → PMTiles
limitations: generalized regional context rather than street-level cartography
boundaries and labels are cartographic reference data and do not imply a position on territorial disputes
roads and populated-place labels come from the separate regional OSM context

sources.title: Global Integrated Power Tracker
sources.licence: CC BY 4.0 except records explicitly carrying a different licence in the source dataset
sources.redistribution: live public vector tiles with attribution

sources.title: U.S. Electric Power Transmission Lines (Archive)

not real time

sources.title: California Electric Transmission Lines
sources.redistribution: queried live with attribution

sources.title: BPA Transmission Lines
sources.licence: Public ArcGIS item with BPA informational/best-available-data disclaimer; no explicit redistribution licence

sources.title: Preliminary Monthly Electric Generator Inventory (EIA-860M)
sources.licence: U.S. Government public domain; EIA requests source acknowledgement with publication date
sources.redistribution: all valid continental-U.S. Operating and Planned rows aggregated losslessly to 15,764 Plant ID points; source and output hashes are documented
limitations: monthly inventory is preliminary and may be corrected in a later release
capacity values are inventory estimates, not commitments or live telemetry
Alaska, Hawaii and Puerto Rico are outside the atlas continental-U.S. region

sources.title: RTE overhead lines, underground lines and electrical substations
sources.redistribution: inventory facts and source links only; the current records contain null geometry
limitations: the publisher removed GPS coordinates from the June 2026 public edition for public-safety reasons; no RTE route geometry is drawn from this source

sources.publisher: Institut national de l'information géographique et forestière (IGN)
sources.title: BD TOPO electricity lines and transformer sites
sources.redistribution: queried live by viewport with IGN – BD TOPO attribution
limitations: line geometry loads from zoom 6 to control volume
transformer-site polygons do not publish voltage and load only with the all-voltage filter from zoom 8
the 263322-pylon layer is catalogued but not fetched in the browser

sources.title: OS OpenMap – Local · Electricity Transmission Line
sources.redistribution: all unique Great Britain electricity-transmission-line features are reproduced under OGL 3.0; 245 exact cross-tile duplicates are removed and no geometry is simplified
limitations: OS OpenMap Local is a cartographic product at 1:10000 rather than an electrical network model
the feature type does not publish per-object voltage, circuits, operator, status or electrical connectivity
the atlas keeps these lines visible in neutral grey under voltage filters and explicitly labels their voltage as unpublished

sources.title: BRT TOP10NL · hoogspanningsleiding
sources.redistribution: all 496 UUID-unique TOP10NL features classified exactly as hoogspanningsleiding are reproduced under CC BY 4.0 after a complete 64-partition cursor crawl; 35 byte-identical bbox-boundary duplicates are removed and no geometry is simplified or merged
limitations: BRT TOP10NL is a topographic product at 1:10000 rather than an electrical network model
the feature class does not publish per-object numeric voltage, circuits, operator, status or electrical connectivity
the atlas keeps these lines visible in neutral grey under voltage filters and explicitly labels their voltage as unpublished

sources.publisher: Federal Agency for Cartography and Geodesy (BKG)
sources.title: DLM250 high-voltage transmission lines
sources.redistribution: queried live by viewport with © GeoBasis-DE / BKG attribution
limitations: geometry is generalized at 1:250000
the dataset does not publish per-feature voltage
objects are therefore hidden when the user requests a threshold above 110 kV

sources.title: BBPlG and EnLAG grid-expansion monitoring projects

public access does not itself grant a snapshot redistribution licence

sources.publisher: Plant operators and Swiss Federal Office of Energy (SFOE)
sources.title: Electrical installations with nominal voltage above 36 kV
sources.licence: Open use with source attribution (opendata.swiss terms_by)
sources.redistribution: rendered as the official remote WMS with mandatory source attribution

the raster overlay is enabled only when the selected threshold is 25 kV or all because the service cannot filter individual WMS features by voltage
WMS pixels are not used to infer electrical connectivity

sources.title: Transmission and substation construction disclosure platform
sources.date: snapshot observed 2026-07-26; stage pages last updated 2026-07-20 to 2026-07-22
sources.redistribution: all 848 records exposed by the four numbered public stage lists are normalised as a locally searchable non-spatial inventory; the dashboard's separate total of 849 is preserved and no placeholder record is invented
limitations: the dashboard reported 849 projects (444 + 189 + 202 + 14), while the numbered stage lists exposed 848 records (443 + 189 + 202 + 14) during the verified snapshot
the public lists do not publish reusable coordinates or route geometry; project names, offices and facility types are not geocoded or converted into lines
voltage_kv is populated only when a kV value is explicit in the published project title

sources.title: Renewable-energy hosting capacity by feeder transformer

sources.title: 2024 Annual Report on National Power Reliability
sources.date: 2024 reporting period; published 2025-03-31; local transcription verified 2026-07-26
sources.redistribution: all 51 official reported system records are factually transcribed as a locally searchable non-spatial inventory with source table and page references; the source report itself is not redistributed
limitations: the NEA tables publish system attributes and selected terminal names but no reusable converter-station coordinates or surveyed line routes
no coordinates, straight corridors or schematic geometry are inferred from system or terminal names
the inventory is a 2024 reliability-management snapshot, not live telemetry or an exhaustive 2026 grid inventory

sources.title: Southeastern Tibet to Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area ±800 kV UHVDC project
sources.redistribution: facts summarised and linked; straight corridor geometry is explicitly modelled
